items.text: Today at the Royal Exchange, Andy Burnham and I had a quick drink. His office was busy today, so he seemed in a hurry to get back. We chatted about politics briefly before I left. Later, while watching tennis, I learned Svitolina won her match. Her victory was impressive, adding another win to her record.
